answer: Each epoch a public beacon broadcasts a fresh random seed, and every identity that wants to drink from the oasis of shared rewards must solve one time-locked puzzle bound to that seed and lock a small umber bond that is refunded only after two random peers re-derive the solution. An honest agent solves one puzzle per epoch, cheaply. An attacker with a thousand fakes must solve a thousand fresh puzzles every epoch and lock a thousand bonds, so each fake costs the full price and the flood bill grows with its numbers until it exceeds any reward.
